description: Checks whether the dftracer MCP server serves the current code and content, and refreshes it (rolling reload under the supervisor, content re-link) when it does not.
instructions: server_status(), then dftracer_admin_check(<its output>). code_current failing: under the supervisor call server_reload() and poll server_status until the generation changes; a single-process server cannot swap itself, so tell the user to reconnect the MCP server (or start it with --ha). content_current failing: server_refresh_content(). Never fall back to manual work when what is needed is a restart: say so.
